title: Welcome to the Brick-Force Forum. Please take a moment to read this post.

posts.h:
Welcome to the official Brick-Force Forum.

We hope that this forum will give everyone the opportunity to engage with the community and support or just respond to other players posts.
Infernum is welcoming all contributors here, but we must ask you to follow our guidelines, so we can create a awesome and mature community.
Therefore we would like to ask every user to read these guidelines and our beta FAQ here:

Forum Guidelines: http://www.brick-force.com/forum/announcement.php?f=28

Beta FAQ: http://brick-force.tumblr.com/beta

If everyone is following these guidelines, we will be able to grow and prosper to a great community that is playing a great game.
We are going to fill all categories over the course of time but we will need your help to do this.
Not everyone is able to read english properly and i would really appreciate if those of you who are willing to help their fellow countrymen and women to understand our guidelines. We don't want to ask a single person to do everything on their own for everyone else but maybe try to organize a thread in your language forum and try to organize and share the work to offer every player an equal footing in our community.

We, from Infernum, are proud to welcome an awesome community here and hope that this vision can be achieved with your help.

We are looking forward to welcome you here.

Yours respectfully

Mathias Eck
Community Manager
posts.t: Welcome to the Brick-Force Forum. Please take a moment to read this post.

posts.h:
server-maintenance.jpg
Dear Brick-Forcers,

All servers will go offline on Friday morning to prepare for maintenance.

  • European and US servers will be taken offline at 11:15 CEST (9:15 GMT). Downtime will take several hours. We cannot give a closer estimate of how long servers will be unavailable yet.

Please visit our Facebook and Twitter page to receive regular updates.

A special treat for your ears will be coming next week. We have secured an international all-star lineup of actors whom have voiced the legendary SpongeBob Squarepants!

The six voice acting veterans who have also starred in localized versions of series such as The Simpsons, Pokémon, South Park and Scooby-Doo will bring Brick-Force to life with their vocal energy.

We chose the talents of the SpongeBob stars because we felt their voices would fit well with the Brick-Force universe - after all, the Brick-Force characters also wear square pants!

The English version will feature Kerry Shale, whose numerous videogame credits include Tomb Raider, Killzone and Fable. Shale has provided more voices for video games than any other actor in history.

In other news: Brick-Force has now exceeded half a million registered users and open beta will launch within the next few weeks!

title: Adjustments and Reset to Points & Items

posts.h:
This week, we’ll be making significant changes to the points and item values in Brick-Force. Currently, due to the high number of points on player accounts, it’s difficult for us to test what items are popular, which are too expensive and which may be too cheap.

We want Brick-Force to be balanced and as fun as possible, so to help us balance the points more effectively, we’ll be resetting items and also reducing points (in all three currencies) so that we can gather valuable data to help us balance Brick-Force.

As always, if you have any feedback please do let us know what you think on the official forums.

Thanks again for your continued support throughout the closed beta!
posts.t: Adjustments and Reset to Points & Items

title: Preparations for the VIP Open Beta

posts.h:
Thursday is the day we’ve all been waiting for…. the launch of the Brick-Force VIP Open Beta!

Want to find out more about what to expect? Click here to read the Open Beta announcement.

posts.t: Preparations for the VIP Open Beta

posts.h:
It's been an intense evening for the whole team. We've been working throughout the night, but unfortunately came up against some challenges that prevented us from launching on Thursday 26th April, as was planned.

We will be back again tomorrow and aim to get the VIP Open Beta underway as soon as possible.

title: Welcome to the VIP Open Beta!

posts.h:

Expect numerous improvements when you log in today, such as new building tools, balancing improvements and the hilarious new Spongebob voiceovers. To find out more about the changes, you can find the latest Patch Notes here.

Take advantage of your VIP status to claim an impressive 50% more tokens for your money in the first week of Open Beta.We’ve got plenty more treats planned for you, such as the VIP Package that will be sent out to everyone who logs into Brick-Force during the next two weeks.

Claim 1 of 50 custom Brick-Force outfits by sharing the VIP Badge in our Facebook raffle.

It gets even better - attract the most likes on your YouTube video to win the custom designer Brick Sofaor create the most popular map to win a whooping €1,000 (about $1,300) in cash!

Finally, start polishing your guns and get prepared because there will be two new shooter modes introduced in the near future!Have fun, everyone.

title: Map of the Week: Fantasy sniper map "The Aether" from 9hostliner

posts.h:
Find yourself suspended in midair on a fantasy island in this week’s featured map: ‘The Aether’ from 9hostliner.

This Sniper centric creation combines four islands that players must either climb or descend. Teams start either at the highest point or the lowest point, and must weave their way carefully around the trees and foliage, avoiding snipers from the opposing team.



Due to design of the map and its large size, sniper rifles are strongly favored and other weapons aren’t recommended.

‘The Aether’ is challenging strategically and contains lots of hiding spots; perfect for those who want to train their sniping skills. It’s also appealing visually and the mid-air islands almost remind you of those in James Cameron’s Sci-Fi epic, Avatar!

We hope you have fun playing this week’s pick of the week.
posts.t: Map of the Week: Fantasy sniper map "The Aether" from 9hostliner

title: Brick-Force in 2013 - A closer look at the year ahead

posts.h:
http://www.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_526661174ec00.jpeg

Season 3 Comes to Europe
Brick-Force travels back in time

"Brick by brick" - that is how Brick-Force has evolved since the release about a year ago and brought it to a considerable size. Over two million players have registered and created more than one million maps and fought more than four million matches.
On the 22nd of October, 6pm (5pm UK), the new Season 3 – Bricksaga – will be released and will bring you a whole new gaming experience. New bricks, new costumes, new weapons.

Become a noble knight, a powerful mage, a mischievous thief and much more with our medieval costumes and use our whole new Bricksaga weapons to rule the battlefield.

The new portals will allow you to appear right behind an enemy or lure them into nasty spike traps. Map builders will have a whole new set of bricks to choose from to make their maps even more exciting and open up entirely new ways to play. Why not put your building skills to the test in our Bricksaga Map Building Contest starting on 24th of Ocotober and win cool prizes starting tomorrow!

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pw3C-qZ5yZE

From Pay2Win to Play2Win, Brick-Force now has a completely revamped and fair approach to the item shop. That means more competition, an improved levelling system and much, much more fun.

The features of Season 3 at a glance:

Powerful and magical weapons such as crossbows and wands
New stylish outfits and many more matching accessories in a medieval style
New , functional Bricks as trap doors, spike traps, doors and windows
Conversion to Force Points to simplify everything
Redesign of the Itemshop
Revised Level Progression
Improved Map Manager
UI Optimization

Check out all the various changes in the Patch Notes (http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/19977-Patch-Notes-3-10-269-71).

A detailed (http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/19880-Season-3-Bricksaga-FAQ)FAQ (http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/19880-Season-3-Bricksaga-FAQ)with answers to all the important questions with regard to the changes can be found here (http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/19880-Season-3-Bricksaga-FAQ).

title: Temporary Deactivation of Kick Vote Functionality

posts.h:
Greetings, Soldiers!

Today we updated Brick-Force with a new update – Patch 3.19.328.102. In today’s latest version, we fixed the issue that was causing premium items to sometimes vanish from the Action Panel, the Dragon Staff hitbox was adjusted with the intention of making it more balanced, some of the new, Futuristic Weapons are now upgradeable. Furthermore, we made a few accessibility and interface changes to help improve your game room experience.

One of the other adjustments that we made was the deactivation of player kick functionality. Please rest assured that it won’t be gone forever! It is a temporary change that we decided to do due to the recent connectivity and channel change issues that some of you have been experiencing. We hope to reactivate it again soon once we’ve addressed the connectivity more thoroughly.

Hope you enjoy the latest changes. If you have any feedback for us, feel free to post in the Constructive Feedback forum, Tweet at us or message us on Facebook. We read all of your comments and appreciate the time, energy and enthusiasm that you have for the game.

Until next time!
-Zal

P.S. Click here to view the Patch Notes for 3.19.328.102
posts.t: Temporary Deactivation of Kick Vote Functionality

Hello Community,

Some of you have already noticed that there is an issue with the Black Knight Cape and its 100% experience bonus not working properly.

We have passed this on to our developers, but unfortunately cannot promise that this will be fixed in the foreseeable future and whether the mantle will have the 100% experience bonus afterwards.

Therefore if you don’t want to wait we would like to offer you to contact customer service and ask for a refund. If you already have upgraded the cape, your spent gems will be refunded as well. When contacting customer service, please choose the subject: Black Knight Cape

Customer Service: http://support.infernum.com/

We apologize for any inconvenience.

Hello Brick soldiers,
Your feedback over the last few weeks regarding dishonest players did not go unheard and led to several discussions here at Infernum. Let me assure you, our primary goal is to deliver the most fun and exciting gameplay experience but unfortunately cheaters enjoy disturbing this and we have absolutely zero tolerance for such behavior.

Our first step from today on will be to deactivate the webplayer for the European servers until further notice, which means you have to install the Client version of Brick-Force. You can find the download here: Client Download

Please note that this is just a temporary solution while we are working on the issue.

If you are using a Mac, a possible workaround to install the client is the usage of Apple’s Bootcamp software. Please note that we can neither offer support nor guarantee a flawless gameplay experience while using this software.

You can still use your login to continue playing Brick-Force.
If you would like to switch the region between US <-> EU please login into your account and edit your preferred game server.

If you face issues running the client version please contact customer service so we can fix this for you.

Thanks and enjoy Brick-Force!

title: A New Era - An Open Letter from the Management

posts.h:
Dear Brick-Force Community,

For those of you who don’t know me, my name is Daniel “Danatros” Ullrich, COO and manager at Infernum. Recently, we unfortunately haven’t been able to keep you as completely informed about the upcoming changes relating to Brick-Force as we would have liked to. This is primarily due to the volume of great new content that we are preparing for you. Of course we would rather give you confirmed information, rather than announcing something that is still subject to change.

As an enthusiastic player of shooters and MMOs, it is particularly important for me to receive regular status updates from games providers – you probably feel the same way. That’s why we would like to take this opportunity to apologize. We know, mainly thanks to your numerous reports and suggestions, about the problems, improvement ideas, and bugs that need to be addressed. Right off the bat, I’d like to sincerely thank you all for your engagement in the community and your loyalty to Brick-Force. Together with you, we’d now like to take the next big step for Brick-Force.

Over the past few weeks, with the help of various pizza delivery services and weekends, we have discussed and worked out many things between EXE Games and our departments. As a result, you can look forward to a bricktastic May and June with new content, new goals, more information, more events, and increased implementation of your numerous ideas and suggestions.

Season 4: Cowboys & Bricks

One reason why we didn’t release this announcement earlier is that we only agreed upon the full scope of Season 4 with EXE Games last Sunday. The basic scope was actually already decided, but we wanted to see more of your abundant feedback from the forums and Facebook implemented.

I don’t want to reveal too much yet, but we will introduce several new game modes and options, revamped player rewards, new maximum levels, new normal bricks with new functions, new weapons and armor, and of course special Season 4 bricks, weapons, and armor into Brick-Force. New game functions, such as crouching and a system for using abandoned weapons, as well as various improvements, will also be implemented with Season 4.

The first patch marking the start of Season 4 will appear in early June. Due to the size and the scope of the content, the season will be completed with two additional patches in the middle and end of that month. Throughout the entire release phase, we will keep you up-to-date with content pages, an improved Brick-Force website, news, and newsletters. We are already excited to see who among you will be the “fastest hands” in Season 4.

Cheaters Not Welcome!

A few weeks ago, we deactivated the web player in order to counteract players who exploited weaknesses in the game engine. This was not an easy decision, but we considered it a necessary measure due to these cheaters who were causing honest players undue frustration.

Infernum will also continue to maintain a “zero tolerance policy” against cheaters in Brick-Force! We all want to have fun while playing, and we have absolutely no sympathy for people who negatively influence the gaming experience of others.

Therefore, EXE Games is currently switching Brick-Force over to a new engine version and integrating comprehensive anti-cheat mechanisms into the web player. We can’t promise that the game will stay cheat-free because there are unfortunately always people who want to gain an advantage, but we will take more drastic action against them in the future. Of course, we would have preferred to deliver you more Season 4 content; however, we had to effectively clamp down on the cheaters by putting some of our development efforts into that problem. Thanks to these efforts, you will surely be happy to learn that we will bring the web player back with Season 4!
posts.t: A New Era - An Open Letter from the Management

posts.h:
Improvements Based on Your Feedback

It’s incredible how much feedback you have given us since the open beta. It’s really terrific! Unfortunately we will not be able to implement all of it. However, the developers of Brick-Force did try to take some of your suggestions into account for Season 4. These include, among others, the development of more wood bricks, a chat filter, chat spam monitoring, adjustments to the interface, streamlining the weapon and armor upgrade system, a non-deletable core brick, and much more.

We have additionally turned our attention to several bugs and improvements reported by you, including but not limited to a penalty for “self-kills” and a solution to the “glitching” problem. We will let you know more about these issues soon.

Weapon and Armor Sales

You may have already noticed a change in our sales approach. We will continue on this road and offer you fewer, but better, sales in Brick-Force. The Pick ‘N’ Win will receive a new high-level set including weapons which will replace the old orange weapons as the strongest firepower in the game. One way this set can be obtained is through Pick ‘N’ Win Coins, which you get for logging in regularly or completing tasks, for example.

While researching for these weapons, we realized that you were irritated with our use of the word “rare” in connection with our orange weapons – and rightly so. That was of course not our intention, and we have since stopped this policy. To help these serious shooters revive their tarnished image, we will only offer the not-so-rare orange weapons once a month. For the last time in May, they will be available from Wednesday, 21/05, to Friday, 23/05.

Communication

Even though Deacer and GraveBear are doing their best to keep you informed about what’s going on at Infernum, things move pretty fast in the world of Brick-Force, as you may have noticed.

Therefore, we would like to somewhat change the way we communicate with you by starting a thread called “Talk to Infernum”. This is where we will keep you up-to-date about everything and answer as many questions as possible. We promise to regularly converse with you there. We may even manage to get on there every day – at least that is our goal. You are the ones who make Brick-Force what it is, and that’s why we want to discuss things with you more directly and listen to your opinions! We’re looking forward to it!

See you in the Brick-World,

Daniel

Greetings Brick-Soldiers,
Today we are continuing our series “Brick-Heroes”, which focuses on you, the players.

Every Friday, we’ll put the spotlight on a member of the community because, after all, you’re the ones who make this game so great. You deserve a bit of recognition.

What's your name in Brick-Force?
My name is BattleFly.

Are you in a clan? If so, what's its name?
I’m a member of EliteSWAT.

Are you looking for members?
No, currently not.

What's your favourite weapon, and why especially this one?
My favourite weapon is the Spider because it makes me remember fond moments I have experienced in Brick-Force.

Do you have a favourite costume?
Yes, I do – it’s the “Black Knight Outfit” which Dr. Brickula wears.

Which game mode do you like most?
Defusion is my favourite mode at the moment.

And on which map are you mainly roaming around?
I prefer to play on the standard maps from Brick-Force.

Did you ever build a map yourself?
Yes, I did – around 30 different ones! Most of them are large maps, for example my latest one, ''Mystery'', which contains more than 103,000 bricks!

What is your favourite season so far, and for which reason?
My favourite season was season 2, "Brickstar", because I really liked the stuff which was implemented back then. Most of all I liked the gravity bricks. I had a lot of fun with them!

What times are people most likely to see you in Brick-Force?
Usually I’m online between 11:00am and 01:00pm in the afternoon, or on Saturdays and Sundays.

What was your most exciting moment in Brick-Force?
That’s a difficult question … I had many nice moments, but I think the one I appreciate the most is the moment season 2 was introduced.

Do you have a good suggestion for our new players?
Play fair – please don’t cheat!

Here's the place for audacious advertisement: Do you have an own YouTube channel with Brick-Force Let's Plays?
I uploaded 3 episodes of me playing Brick-Force to my channel “SzczypiorTV”, but as of now I don’t plan to produce more.

Map Rules:

1. The map must consist of at least 15,000 bricks.
2. The map must be playable.
3. The map must be balanced and fair.
4. The map must be submitted by its builder.
5. The map must be new, i.e. it must be registered during the contest period. Existing maps which are reregistered will not be eligible.
6. The map must be completed and registered before submission.

Submission Rules:

7. Your submission post must include the name of the map. Be careful to avoid typos because the map cannot be evaluated if the name is not correct.
8. You must provide the following map details: number of bricks and supported game modes.
9. Screenshots of the map are preferred but not required unless additional rules specify otherwise.

Rules of Conduct:

10. Posting offensive or discriminatory content or symbols is strictly prohibited.
11. Remakes of maps by other players or from other games will not be considered – we want to judge your own creativity, not your ability to copy the work of others.
12. There will be consequences if anyone submits someone else’s work as their own.

Any additional rules for specific contests can be found in the news on our website and in the forum.
Any violation of the Rules of Conduct will result in disqualification from the contest, and there may be additional consequences.
Furthermore, the contest thread is only to be used for posting submissions, not for discussion or private conversations. All spam will therefore be deleted without comment.

Dear Community,

We know how important the web player is to you, and that’s why we invested so much time over the past weeks in order to bring it back. In just one and a half months of development, a Unity update was performed and various programs were installed to improve performance and also to avoid cheats. Regrettably we must now inform you that, with a heavy heart, we had to decide to deactivate it again.

We are not taking this situation lightly. A critical error in the operation of the web player has forced us to take this step. Shortly after it went live again yesterday, it became evident that a critical error can occur with a certain number of players.

Not only does this detract from everyone’s gaming experience, it also affects the game’s stability, and unfortunately this was not detectable during testing.

Unfortunately we cannot go into specific details at this point, and I ask for your understanding in this regard.

In order to avoid a detrimental gaming experience over the weekend, we will have to deactivate it again. However, we are confident that EXE will already be able to deliver a fix next week.

Until then, we’d like to remind you that players having difficulty with the installation of the client version should please get in touch with our customer support. You can do that here: http://support.infernum.com/index.php

We also noticed that some of our players have already found a new loophole for some cheats. One positive effect of shutting down the web player is that we’ll stop these cheaters as well. We would like to remind you once again that all instances of cheating will be dealt with by our customer service team and we follow a zero-tolerance policy on this matter.

We apologize for any inconvenience, and we will keep you posted as the situation develops.

Kind Regards,

Dear Brick-Force Community,

First of all, we would like to thank you again for your faithful commitment to Brick-Force and for the close attention you are paying to our beloved game and its future.

Yesterday morning, we noticed an alarming number of worries and questions relating to Infernum Productions’ situation that I would like to address in this post. Your inquiries were triggered by the publication of a press article announcing Infernum’s filing of an application for a preliminary insolvency.

This information is true; Infernum is indeed initiating a restructuring process supported by the opportunities offered by German insolvency law for the restructuring of companies. But rest assured that the most alarmist assumptions stated in said article are thankfully inaccurate.

What is going on exactly?
Due to underperforming revenues in the last few months, Infernum has indeed started to undertake a restructuring process.
This process is using the opportunities of German insolvency law for the restructuring of companies. The first step of the restructuring was the filing of an application for insolvency at the Berlin insolvency court together with an application for a debtor-in-possession proceeding. This specific proceeding allows the general direction and administration board of the company to keep on leading the company through a process aimed at lowering costs and sanitizing the company’s financial situation.

Our main goal currently is to keep our games running and to keep on delivering the best experience possible to our communities, including the very important Brick-Force players’ community.

The insolvency expert Thomas Illy, in charge of the financial restructuring, states: “After revision of the current situation we are optimistic that Infernum Productions AG will overcome this critical phase in a positive way and the business operations can continue.“

First steps to implement the insolvency plan have already been initiated, including plans to lower the overhead costs, which should come into effect in the next few weeks. Additionally, potential investors and shareholders are being looked for to speed up the restructuring process.

The official procedure will start on December 1st 2014 and be concluded in March 2015.

What does it mean for Brick-Force?
For now, literally nothing! We’ve been working hard those last weeks to make sure that the reduction of our workforce does not negatively impact player experience and have, so far, succeeded smoothly.
Let’s say it clearly: This is not the end of Brick-Force! Brick-Force is not being discontinued, servers are not shutting down, and your account and character data is safe.

How can I support Brick-Force?
If you want to support Infernum and Brick-Force through this restructuring phase, a simple and easy way is to have a look to our outgame or ingame marketplace and to treat yourself with a little boost or a shiny gun from time to time. Did you know that less than 10% of Brick-Force active players actually spend money on the game? Just a little increase of that number could make a huge difference for the future!

If you wish to support the game but don’t find any of our offers attractive, please tell us what you’d like to buy on the feedback forums, and we might make it happen. It’s the magic of online games!
If you are one of the many players who are enjoying Brick-Force for free and wish to keep it that way, do not hesitate to talk about the game, or even better, to invite friends!

What happens next?
In all honesty, it is indeed a difficult time for our company. The situation requires extra effort and extra involvement from each employee, but be sure that we are doing our very best so that it doesn’t affect your game experience. We, as a team, have faith and confidence in our capabilities of turning this situation around and to keep on operating Dragon’s Prophet, Brick-Force, and Hazard Ops for a long and happy time.

Thank you again for your continuous support and for all the kind words we’ve already received. We invested a lot of sweat and passion into our games, and it goes straight to our hearts.
Should you have any further questions or worries, do not hesitate to voice them as an answer to this post, and we will do our best to answer them.

- The Community Team

Q&A Critical questions


Does that mean that the servers will be shut down soon?
It is still our top priority to continue the operation and service of all our titles in the future and beyond the timeframe of the restructuring process. Despite underperforming revenues in the first half of 2014, we are very optimistic that Brick-Force, Dragon’s Prophet, and Hazard Ops will still be available to all players in 2015.

What will happen to my in-game characters?
We are planning to continue the operation of all servers. Thus, all in-game characters will still be available so that you can continue to enjoy the worlds of Brick-Force, Dragon’s Prophet, and Hazard Ops. Should the restructuring not go as planned, we will do our best to come up with a solution that is the best for everyone. As a precaution, we are currently talking to several parties to come up with a quick solution.

Will there soon be no customer support/community management?
The continuous dialogue between publishers and players is an extremely important part of business, especially for online games with big communities. Consequently, we will continue to respond to all support tickets within our capacities and our community management team will still take care of their respective player base, plan exciting events, and collect feedback to send it to our developers.

What happens to currently running contests?
Especially in our current situation, we are not doing anything without carefully thinking about the feasibility and realization of each project. This includes contests of all kinds as well. Rest assured that every contest will take place without any restrictions and that the respective winners will be rewarded as announced.

Will there be no more updates for the games?
Our developers EXE Games, Runewaker Entertainment, and Yingpei Games are not affected by our current situation and continue to work at full speed to deliver new content for their respective game. Dragon’s Prophet will see the release of new zones and features in the next months, Brick-Force players can look forward to a new season, and there is already a lot of content for Hazard Ops waiting to be released in accordance to our time plan.

Will update XYZ/Season XYZ be postponed?
We obviously can’t rule out the postponement of an update. This doesn’t necessarily have something to do with our current situation, but is a general risk instead that can be attributed to several factors. Usually, we will only announce the release date of an update when we are certain that we can stick to it in the end.

Should I stop spending money?
We will continue to run the servers for our games, so there is no reason to stop spending money. On the contrary, if you want to support Infernum and its games, now would be the best time to do so.

What happens to the money I invested? Will there be a reimbursement? How much will I get back and when?
Since we are not planning to discontinue any of our games, we cannot make any statement regarding reimbursements as of now. Ideally, this question is redundant anyway as we are trying our very best to keep up the operation of our games.

Chat Rules

Dear Brick-Forcer,

Unfortunately, in the past, the chat has been repeatedly confusing to players and could not be used properly due to an ever-growing amount of spam messages. We would like the chat to return to what it used to be and what it is supposed to be: A place, where players can talk normally and in quiet and where spam and insults find no platform.

For this reason, we decided to introduce three chat moderators in the shape of Kalchas, Clone117 and boopboop, who will have a look at the chat and moderate it if necessary. You will recognise them by the colour of their writing which is orange, rather than yellow. They have the right to temporarily mute players, who don’t stick to the rules, and they are in direct contact with our support, to which they will report grave violations instantly.

In the following, you will find an overview over what we expect from all of you with regards to chat behaviour and a list of chat rules:

  • Spam
    Nobody likes spam. The repeated posting of the same message within a short timeframe, as well as the senseless posting of number and letter sequences or the writing in CAPS are not allowed.

  • Insults
    We want a normal tone and friendly interactions amongst our players. Personal insults and provocations are thus not an accepted way of interaction. Treat your co-players with respect and be fair to each other.

  • „Who wants Tokens?“
    Everybody knows that hardly anybody is willing to give away Tokens just like that and without wanting something in return. In spite of this, accounts are being chiselled out of people over and over again. In order to prevent this from happening in the future, any comment, which indicates giving away Tokens for free will be treated as attempted account fraud and will be suitably punished.

  • Account Sale/ Trade
    Selling, giving away or trading of accounts is not allowed according to our Terms of Service. Comments which indicate that such a goal is being pursued will thus be forwarded to support right away. Authors of such comments might face permanent account bans.

  • HTML
    The Brick-Force chat is not made for HTML and might be damaged from using commands, which have a direct impact on client fonts and which might cause crashes. We understand that it is fun to experiment with colours and font sizes, but we are asking you to refrain from using them in the future.


Questions & Answers


How often and in which intervals can I post something without it being viewed as spam?

It is allowed to advertise certain rooms every 20 minutes. However, advertising Boards is only allowed once per hour.

Clan requests and Clan offers can be posted every 15 minutes.

You are allowed to advertise your own Brick-Force LPs or maps every 30 minutes.

Private advertising or advertisements for events and games outside of the Brick-Force world are generally prohibited.

Please note that these restrictions cannot be avoided simply if various different players post the same or a similar text repeatedly (for example advertising the same room). Even if you arrange for several players posting such comments right after one another in the chat, this still counts as spam.

I only said this in jest. Why am I being punished?

Our moderators are not omniscient. They cannot know whether something was said in jest, and especially if other players might find something offensive or not. Thus, you will have to anticipate that anything you post is being taken seriously and that such excuses won’t work. This holds true especially in cases of account trading or Token scams.

You are solely responsible for anything you post, even if you only repeat something that somebody else posted previously. The moderators cannot track everything, so re-posting something might lead to you having to answer for it in the same way as the original author of the text.

Why am I being punished harder than other players?

There are fixed rules on which offense is punished with which mute period. If you, for example, have caught the mods’ attention numerous times before, this can have a negative impact on the duration of your next mute. Within this context, different types of offenses cannot be taken into account.

Please note that your chances to be accepted into programmes and events such as “Brick-Heroes” will decrease, the more you stand out negatively in the chat.

As matches in Build & Destroy are currently subject of bad player behaviour, we have decided to fix the following set of rules for this mode in order to keep up the fun.

  1. Exploiting bugs of any kind is expressly forbidden. This includes wall-glitch-bugs as well as ones which get you to the opponents’ side during Build phase.
  2. Griefing – The removal/destruction of bricks placed by other players and the deliberate hindrance of a team through other means is forbidden. This also (and especially) holds true for “griefers” changing into the opponents’ team after the Build phase in order to profit from their own deeds.

These two rules are binding for all players. Any violations will be rigorously punished. We thank you for your understanding.

Introduction

The Brick-Agent Programme is a group of users who directly help the Brick-Force Community Team with basic tasks. Recently, the Brick-Agent programme was updated and got some new guidelines and revised methods of receiving the rank.

How you can get this rank

To get this rank, you must complete one of the following things:

1. Get one of the following Brick-Brigade ranks:

• Fabulous Fansiter
• Badass Blogger
• Yummy Youtuber
• Brilliant Builder
• Streaming Sensation

Once you have one of these ranks, you must apply to community@brick-force.com with the template at the bottom!

2. Become a Brick-Hero

Brick-Heroes recently experienced a change with receiving this title. In order to become a Brick-Hero, you must now be active within the Brick-Force forum (EN/DE/FR) and have never had a warning or infraction given to you.

3. Hand-picked

Anyone the Brick-Force Community Team sees fit of being a Brick-Agent will be sent some questions via private message over the forum. If the questions find approval by the Brick-Force Community Team, the user will be inducted into the ranks of the Brick-Agents.

Guidelines as an Agent

1. All Agents are to be active within the Brick-Force forum and actively participate in Agent discussions.
2. All Agents should show the utmost respect to the Brick-Force community and realize their superiors and commanders.
3. No Agent is immune to the rules. If you break a rule as an Agent you will receive the same punishment as any other user. If you receive a warning or infraction you will be removed from the Brick-Agent programme. No Agent is allowed to ever have been muted in game, or given any form of punishment via the forum.
4. All Agents must give up their previous rank to be a part of this team. This is to show pure dedication from all users. There will be no “undercover agents” this time around.
5. Being a Brick-Agent is a privilege, not a right. Treat is as such.

Do I get anything for being a Brick-Agent?

Brick-Agents do not receive any form of payment, but do receive the respect of users and the support of Brick-Force Community Team members. Members of the Brick-Agent program also receive an avatar and title that display them as such.

What tasks do Agents help with?

Brick-Agents help with a multitude of things, with much more to come! Here’s a list of current things members of the Brick-Agent programme help with:
1. Suggestions for Maps of the Week
2. Gaining reports from the community for the Brick-Force Team

The following announcement addresses the new FP exploit, which is occurring since the last weekend. Players create maps with minimal effort and then charge 1000 FP per download. This map is then downloaded in great numbers of accounts of dubious origin and payed with FP of shady origin. This way a lot of cheated FP can be moved to single accounts.

This is, as of now, forbidden. Players who used this in the past are lucky and will not face consequences for it. Players that are caught doing this will not only have all FP gained this way permanently removed, but will also face severe punishment.

These cases will be investigated individually by the Brick-Force-Team, in detail and caution. If you just built a successful map, you are not in automatically in danger. Our only goal is to get rid of this exploit.

Thank you all for your attention! Have fun with Brick-Force!

Washburne & Your Brick-Force-Team

Greetings Brick-Soldiers,
Today we are continuing our series “Brick-Heroes”, which focuses on you, the players.


Every Month, we’ll put the spotlight on a member of the community because, after all, you’re the ones who make this game so great. You deserve a bit of recognition.


1. Tell us your ingame name and what’s the story behind it?

My name is Kagome0615! Originally it supposed to be Kagome or Kagome0625, but the story behind this name is that Kagome are Japanese mythological creatures that are half bunny and half human. Which explains why I have my Bunny Mask on to represent my race!

2. How did Brick-Force get your attention?

Brick-Force was once my very first game I played before Minecraft and other FPS game when I was young. I was an active player in Korea server till it got shut down as I then decided to transfer to US/EU server. The game was announced in Korea and it does look fun and cute, which of course I decided to give it a shot and I really got in love with it!

3. Are you currently in a clan? If so, what’s his name?

Yes, I am currently in the clan named “Kagome”. I am the clan leader of this clan.

4. Is your clan currently looking for new members and what characterizes you as a team?

Well we do look for new members, but the purpose of this clan is to have fun and play together with friends! We don’t do Clan War (The… real Clan War in Clan channel) because mostly this clan is meant for fun, not to prove who’s the strongest.

5. Do you have a favorite main-weapon and why exact this one?

Yes! I have many favorite main-weapons! My affinity on guns is what makes me dangerous and powerful! Of course, I do love to collect many different type of permanent weapons from the shop. But my favorite one is the Fancy Hellgate. Because I am very dangerous in close range combat to my enemies, so I always love to deal heavy damage in close range combat! Just don’t get in my way if you see me pointing my Fancy Hellgate to you

6. There are many different outfits in Brick-Force, what’s your favorite one?

My current favorite outfit and what suits me perfectly is my fancy red, white, and black suits and my beloved shiny Machinima helmet and my Bunny mask. I always get my suits dirty but I will always come back clean in every start of the battlefield! And don’t get fooled by seeing my wearing such a fancy dress in the middle of a dirty battlefield because I dress to kill!

7. What’s the gamemode you like the most?

I usually love to do Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, and most importantly Zombie mode. Because I always either communicate and strategize my teammates on winning in TDM, as I practice my reflexes and my hearing capabilities and danger awareness in Zombie and Deathmatch mode!

8. Do you have a favorite map and what’s the best thing about it?

The favorite thing I usually love the most is Nova Spade. The story that MelodyC (the creator of the map) made that explains the map Nova Spade is what grabs me an attention and it does make a lot sense if you first read whole story then play it! It’s a very beautiful map that I had ever seen back in US server because this map was registered a really long ago!

9. Did you build a map by yourself and do you like to tell us something about your creation?

I have multiple maps that each of them are either connected or separated in different stories. Crimson, Vega, and Stadust are connected to each other as they are based on the story I was working on (which is currently available for members who are age of 18) and the other map called Tangelo is a different story. I usually do love to make an arena maps and much of a fair-path maps! The design and the way it created is designed to be fair to all teams!

10. Which season did you start with and what was your favorite season so far?

I started since Season 1 or like the time Brick-Force was first launched and released in Korea. But for now, my favorite Season would be Season 2 because I really do love high-technologies and most of the cool futuristic-theme contents! Science is cool! Seriously!

11. At what time can you be found in Brick-Force? (GMT, KST or CET)
Are you active at the forum?

I can be active any times of course! However, I will not be active and be seen in action from 4:00 PM CET to 12:00 PM CET. Sometime I may have a small chance to be online during the time I’m not supposed to be online. But the purpose and the reason for me to stay online and active in most time is because I would love to have a responsibility to make sure that the server is in good-environment and making sure that there’s no those pesky cheaters on the loose!

12. Tell us about your most exciting Brick-Force moment.

One of the most exciting Brick-Force moment I have done and experienced was creating a famous and a well-known fair map that made me popular and makes everyone to get to know me! I’m like the other famous and well-known Brick-Force Soldiers out there! I’m not alone!

13. Do you have a good tip for the new player base in Brick-Force?

The tip for new recruits of the Brick-Force! When you see an enemy, or struggling on a heavy fire as you take cover, never stop moving in combat! Heh, that’s even my motto which motivates the soldiers not to be the easiest target in the battlefield! It’s actually part of the lyric that I always love to listen the most: “Keep Rushing and a running, running! The drumming of the buckshot punpin'!”

And another tip! If you want to know which weapons would suit you perfectly in the battlefield, message me! I will answer them and will always recommend you a best weapon that you're capable with and that fits you well! Your honest Weapon God Kagome will always do his best job on helping you regarding about guns! No seriously! I have like a whole collection and a huge array of weapons in my closet as my collection and I still use them!

14. If you want to advertise something this is your opportunity.
Feel free to tell us your YouTube-channel, Twitch, etc. or a youtuber, streamer, etc. you like to watch.

I also have a YouTube Channel that all Brick-Force soldiers and members would wish to come and visit the channel! I of course make Brick-Force arts, speed paints, Weapon Showcase, Let’s Play, Funny Moments and so on! Well there is some non-Brick-Force related videos, but the channel is mostly dedicated to Brick-Force!
https://www.youtube.com/c/Kagome0625
And if you wish to talk to me on Discord, I will provide you guys a link for my Discord group so we can talk and communicate together during the game! And most importantly you won’t have to miss something nice or important! The server was first created just a while ago and it’s new and fresh >w<.
https://discord.gg/vtfhCHj

Some small bits of information were already presented to you last month. But today, we will show you what this is all about!

Place and time are already known – August 23rd will be the day we’ll burn the dancefloor – and you can’t miss that!

But what exactly is it we are planning? We want to celebrate an unforgettable party night!

What do you need for that?

An awesome location – the “Wartesaal am Dom” is exactly that!

Food and drinks – we got you!

Music – we are bringing talented DJs with us, like Sarazar and “Circle of Alchemist”. That means: Hit the dancefloor!

See you in Cologne!

The Summer is here!

And this is what we celebrate with a bricktastic Event and Prizes!





Here is an overview of the entire event:

The event starts on 19th June ’2017 and runs over 11 weeks, each week is played around another summer weapon. The associated Eventaccount is called EventSunny. Sunny could appear with a double or a protector. So be on your guard.

Rules:

  • - Your task is to kill Sunny with the summer weapon, which you can get using the following Promotion Code during the Holidays: "BananasEvent".
  • - The event rounds take place exclusively on the FUN servers, to allow each player the opportunity to participate.
  • - If you are caught hacking, bugging or other criminal activities, you will be automatically excluded from the event and you will be charged with reasonable penalties.
  • - Whoever intentionally and in high numbers kills with a wrong weapon, can be excluded from the event!

Any further rules, as well as announcements from existing team members, must be always followed!

Profits:

Each player can win each of the 11 summer weapons as a 7 to 30 days max up version. The permanent winnings, however, are divided into 11 players!
How you get the winnings you see here, it ONLY count the kills with the respective weapon of the week. You always get only one code for the weapon with which you made the kills.

  1. Kills --- 7-Tage version of the weapon (Max Up)
  2. Kills --- 14-Tage version of the weapon (Max Up)
  3. Kills --- 30-Tage version of the weapon (Max Up)

The melee weapons as well as the grenades can unfortunately not be issued as a Max Up version, so these weapons are only distributed as day versions without upgrades. The winners of the permanent version are still upgrading 10 Elite Stones.

At the draw for the permanent version of the weapon you take part automatically with the first kill of this weapon. How many kills do you have in the end does not matter. Here is the overview of the weapon we currently have:

On August 23, 2017, the #gamigoVIParty starts! We have prepared a little surprise for this unprecedented event, just for you. We are giving away some prizes beforehand and the main prize is a round-trip-carefree package for you and a companion of your choice. This package includes a golden ticket, which not only guarantees you VIP entrance to the party, but also guarantees free drinks for the whole evening. Attention! - we put one more thing on it and not only take care of your round trip expenses, but your overnight hotel stay! In addition you have the possibility to visit the Gamescom for a whole day with this ticket. Does that sound good? Good!

What do you have to do to win?
Just send us a short application! Impress us with your creativity! There are hardly any limits.
You can send us the application in the form of a video (whether you use your characters from the game or if you dare to go into the big wide world), a short story with a maximum of 1,000 words, a motivation letter or a small collage. If you do not like our ideas, then let something else come to you – be unique and convince us that you really, really ... really want to join this party!

So ... once again the most important in points!

What is there to win?
• 1st place: A round-care package for 2
• 2nd place: VIP entrance to the party for 2
• 3rd place: Entrance to the party for 2

What do I have to do?
• Create a video (whether in the game or outside), or
• Write a short story, or
• Create a collage, or
• Let yourself be inspired by something else so you will stick out of the crowd!

Are there rules?
• You must be at least 18 years old to win.
• Submit your application by midnight latest on 04.07.2017 in this form!
• The short story must contain a maximum of 1,000 words.
• gamigo reserves the right to exclude persons from participation if there is a reasonable suspicion that they have violated one of these conditions. In such cases, the profit can also be subsequently recognized and a substitute winner be issued.
• The profit is non-transferable and can not be paid in cash as an alternative. Gamigo reserves the right to replace any individual profit at any time with an equal or higher value profit. An issue of profits to minors is excluded.
• If there are differences of opinion regarding the rules, the course or the results of the contest, gamigo's decision is final. Any legal process is excluded.
• The data are treated confidentially by gamigo and in accordance with the legal data protection regulations.
• gamigo Group employees and their members, as well as Gamemaster and their dependents are prohibited from entering this contest.

We wish you good luck and we hope to see you at the gamigoVIParty!

Greetings Community,

As you might have noticed, no developer-diary has been published. Fact is, sadly: we had to stop the development of Brick-Force. The original developer left us the game in a state that makes it impossible for us to extend or update the game. That means we are not able to apply bugfixes or new content.

At the same time, we must announce that our last active member, WashburneX, will leave the game. Support and sales will no longer happen. We hope we will find a solution for the sales, but for the time being, there won’t be any new sales.

If you have any support-requests, please ask the remaining community-moderators and your co-players. All request we receive that are not payment-related will not be handled.

Regarding the elephant in the room: No, we will not shut down the game yet. We will inform you when the time comes.

Thank you all for your loyalty and the fun we had. We hope we can continue to have more of it for a long time to come.
Thanks for everything and till then!
Cheers!
WashburneX & Your Brick-Force-Team
